blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Vitamins D3 and K2 are a dynamic duo for supporting bone and cardiovascular health. Contains the bioactive and highly bioavailable D3 and K2 (MK-7) forms.

The Isura® seal is your assurance that this product is independently verified as clean and safe, and has been tested for over 800 possible contaminants. This product is Isura verified clean, one of the highest testing standards in the world.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: 1 softgel per day with food or as directed by a health care professional.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Softgel (gelatin, glycerin, purified water, caramel color), medium chain triglycerides (from RSPO-certified palm oil and coconut oil), yellow beeswax, sunflower lecithin.
Contains no artificial preservatives or sweeteners; no dairy, wheat, gluten, yeast, sesame, egg, fish, shellfish, salt, or GMOs.
Manufactured by Natural Factors to ensure safety and potency in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) of the FDA and Health Canada.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Consult a health care professional before use, especially if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, are taking medication, or have a medical condition. Keep out of the reach of children.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is broken. For freshness, store in a cool, dry place.
